Pin config.objdiff_tag to a known-good version. <unit>: <function> lies outside the code sections .init, .text The platform's code sections are named differently; pass code-sections to the action. <unit>: data sections do not add up to total_data A unit's total_data disagrees with its section sizes; usually the same objdiff version problem. history: duplicate revision , history: rows out of order , <slug>/<id>: history lacks the latest revision The data repository's existing files are inconsistent; someone edited them by hand. Revert that commit in the data repository. push failed (attempt N), retrying then push failed after 5 attempts Five consecutive lost races or a rejected push. Re-run the job; if it persists, check the App's permission and branch rules on the data repository. <slug>/<id> <sha> already published Not an error: the revision was published before (a re-run). The first measurement of a revision wins. Deploy and page Symptom Cause and fix The data repository has the commit but the page is old The data repository's Deploy workflow takes about a minute and queues bursts; wait, then reload. If Deploy did not run, the Pages source is not set to GitHub Actions. A target shows "unavailable" Its latest.json does not load or parse. A map.json or history.json that fails the page's checks hides only its own section ("Progress history unavailable"). Run publish.py check on a clone of the data repository to find the file. The game is missing from the hub Its slug is not in index.json ; the first publish adds it. Check that the publish step ran on main (the condition is github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' ). /games/<slug>/ returns 404 with the application shell Normal for a game added since the last site deploy; the page still renders. The next site deploy stages a real file. No cover Both halves are needed: data/<slug>/cover.webp in the data repository and artwork in config/site.json followed by a publish. No Contribute link contributions.accepting is false , or there is no guideUrl , or the target has no report. The history chart has one point Expected after the first publish; every later main publish adds one. Review gate Symptom Cause and fix Owner review clearance stays pending In order: the PR is a draft; the clearance is not by REVIEW_OWNER ; Revision: is not the current head; the two links are the same, malformed or point at another PR; a linked record's revision or verdict is wrong; a header line appears twice. The acceptance matrix in Review gate lists every case. The workflow does not run on comments It is not on the default branch yet, or the comment is on an issue rather than a PR. The status never appears on a PR from a fork By design; fork PRs are not cleared and not built. Recovery A bad publish is a git revert in the data repository; the next publish appends on top. A bad image digest is a revert of the validate.yml change. Never edit measurement files in the data repository by hand, and never loosen a check, change a count or alter the build image to make a contribution pass; report the problem in an issue for the owner.

title: Starter kit
summary: The downloadable files, their parameters, the acceptance checklist and an agent prompt.
text: Starter kit The downloadable files, their parameters, the acceptance checklist and an agent prompt. Download the repository starter archive . It unpacks to repository-starter/ and contains every copyable file this guide refers to, the data contract, and nothing that pretends to be a build system. The same files are browsable in the site repository under docs/wiki/starter/ . Contents File Copy to Chapter README.md nowhere; it lists the parameters this one AGENTS.md , CONTRIBUTING.md , .gitignore , .github/pull_request_template.md the repository root and .github/ Contribution workflow .github/workflows/validate.yml.template .github/workflows/validate.yml CI .github/workflows/review.yml.template .github/workflows/review.yml Review gate config/targets.json , config/site.json , config/ci-targets.json , config/README.md config/ Targets , Evidence tools/__init__.py , tools/targets.py , tools/ci_targets.py , tools/verify_target.py , tools/measuring_tools.py tools/ Targets , CI tests/test_targets.py , tests/review_gate.mjs tests/ CI , Review gate build-image/Dockerfile , build-image/.github/workflows/image.yml , build-image/README.md the root of the private repository Build environment contract/README.md reference only Data contract Not included, because they are the project's own: README.md , configure.py and the rest of dtk-template, config/<target id>/ , src/ and include/ . Parameters Every project-specific value, and where it goes: Parameter Value Files Public repository owner/game CONTRIBUTING.md , tests/review_gate.mjs , build-image/README.md Owner login OWNER_LOGIN ; also the REVIEW_OWNER variable AGENTS.md , CONTRIBUTING.md , tests/review_gate.mjs Slug game config/site.json Target ids GAME01-rev0 , GAME01-rev1 config/targets.json , config/ci-targets.json , AGENTS.md , CONTRIBUTING.md , build-image/* Target display strings label , region , revision config/targets.json Original SHA-1 40 lower-case hex digits config/targets.json , build-image/Dockerfile Presentation title , shortTitle , console , year , contributions , artwork config/site.json Build image owner/game-build and its digest validate.yml.template PARAMETER 1, build-image/README.md Original path sys/main.dol validate.yml.template PARAMETER 2, tools/verify_target.py , build-image/* Configure and build commands your toolchain's validate.yml.template PARAMETER 3 Credential names DATA_APP_CLIENT_ID , DATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY validate.yml.template PARAMETER 4 Reported tool versions dtk_tag , objdiff_tag tools/measuring_tools.py Toolchain archives, toolkit tag and commit build-image/Dockerfile , build-image/.github/workflows/image.yml Acceptance checklist The repository is set up when each line is true and can be shown with a run, a commit or a URL. The public repository has the layout in Repository layout ; git status after a local build shows no original or generated file. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' and node --test tests/review_gate.mjs pass locally. python3 tools/verify_target.py --target <id> reports the SHA-1 verified, and ninja -f build/<id>/build.ninja produces the byte-identical executable. ninja -f build/<id>/build.ninja progress build/<id>/report.json writes a report that publish.py publish --dry-run converts and publish.py check accepts. The private repository's image workflow is green on main , the package is private, the public repository has Read access, and validate.yml names the digest. A pull request runs Plan affected targets , Tool tests , Validate <id> and Validate targets , all green, and shows Owner review clearance pending. review.yml is on main ; a test clearance turns the status green; a new commit turns it pending. Branch protection requires both checks. The GitHub App is installed on the data repository; the producer holds the variable and the secret. The first main run's Publish to the site step printed published <slug>/<id> <sha> ; the data repository has the commit; https://mitsevox.github.io/games/<slug>/ shows it. Cover art is committed to the data repository and artwork is in config/site.json , or the owner has decided to go without. Prompt for an agent Set up a decompilation repository by following the guide in handbook.md exactly, using the files in repository-starter/. The project parameters are: <platform>, <toolchain and versions>, <target ids with labels, regions, revisions and SHA-1s>, <slug and presentation>, <owner login>, <public repository>, <private build repository>. Do not invent any other value. Work through the chapters in the order Start here gives. Copy each starter file to its destination and fill only the marked parameters. Where the guide names a command, run it and report its output; where a step needs the owner (creating the private repository, committing the original, installing the GitHub App, setting repository variables, secrets, package access or branch protection), stop and list exactly what the owner must do. Finish with the acceptance checklist from the Starter kit chapter: for each line, the evidence (command output, commit, run or URL) or the reason it is not yet true. Never substitute a placeholder for a real value to make a check pass, never commit an original, and never change the build image, the review workflow or branch protection on your own.
